release_changes: Changed descriptor version and display name from v2.0c2 test to v2.0 stable.
Renamed install folder and outer .mod file to v2.0 release names.
Removed test wording from Chinese and English decision-category localisation.
Updated one source comment from v2.0c2 to v2.0.
No gameplay effects, decisions, templates, variants, events or building logic changed.
stable_features: Universal human-player initialization: all technologies, preset doctrines and service spirits.
22 equipment designs, 8 division templates and massive stockpiles for all human countries.
Generic templates use infantry; PRC templates retain militia where designed.
Optional full-army conversion to Garrison Force.
One-time decision raising 24 full-strength Main Infantry Divisions.
Universal building slots, petrochemical, dockyard, civilian industry, transport/base and defense decisions.
Construction limited to states both owned and controlled by the current country.
PRC-only advisers, configured MIO traits, Chinese model names, 23 supply hubs and dual grids.
No grids or Chinese supply hubs for other countries.
AI weight zero and zero political-power decision costs.
